audience: people who plan tasks, projects and working hours in Motion and want an AI assistant to read them

useCases.title: Review the tasks in a workspace
useCases.text: List the workspaces you belong to, then list the tasks of one workspace, filtered by project or assignee. Open a task to read its due date and status.

useCases.title: Check the projects in a workspace
useCases.text: List the workspaces, then list the projects in one of them with their status and custom field values.

useCases.title: Check your working hours and time zone
useCases.text: Confirm which Motion account is connected, then read the weekly hours and time zone of each working schedule.

useCases.title: Create a task from a request
useCases.text: Pick a workspace, then create a task from what you describe. Each call adds a new task, so check the details first.
